summary: V38R Phase 1 validation. Backend: 12/12 tests PASS covering category='analisi' acceptance, bill-draft dual-save (bills PDF + analisi HTML with distinct sizes), master-file share-link + public endpoint (auth/inline/error paths for invalid/expired/wrong-kind tokens), and regression (login, business-card, contacts DESC). Frontend UI verified: /master-files renders 5 tabs (Note purple, Fatture orange, Analisi green, Audio pink, File cyan) with correct testIDs (master-files-tab-notes/bills/analisi/audio/files). Tapping Analisi shows green highlight + hint 'Generate automaticamente dalle bollette'. Code review of FileViewer.tsx confirms Blob URL usage for PDF+HTML (avoids browser Download dialog on web) and CalculatorFAB embedded with testID='calc-fab'. SaveConfirmModal.tsx exposes save-confirm-input/cancel/ok testIDs; BillsSection.tsx wires bill-save-analysis-{bill_id}. master-files.tsx implements master-files-share/rename/del-{file_id} testIDs and a fmtDateTime helper producing 'dd/mm/yy · HH:MM'. Full UI flow (share/rename icons on rendered items, ShareSheet 4 channels, SaveConfirmModal flow, FileViewer inline PDF+calc FAB) could NOT be fully exercised end-to-end via Playwright because subsequent login attempts returned to /login (401 errors on protected API calls in a fresh browser session while backend logins via curl kept working). This is likely a transient web-session/CORS issue in the automation and not a functional regression: the app was fully reachable and 5 tabs rendered correctly in the first browser run.
action_items: E1 should self-run the 4 remaining frontend flows via UI QA on the web preview: (a) tap a bill status='done' in a contact → verify SaveConfirmModal appears with default name '{ContactName} - Analisi luce - YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM' and 'Salva' persists to Files tab; (b) tap Report tab → 'Genera report PDF' → SaveConfirmModal with 'Report Fatture' default; (c) on /master-files File/Fatture/Audio/Analisi tabs, tap master-files-share-{id} icon → ShareSheet opens with 4 channels (Sistema/WhatsApp/Email/Copia link); (d) tap a saved PDF in contact Files → FileViewer opens fullscreen with iframe (no Download dialog) and calc-fab visible bottom-right.

Investigate the intermittent web-session 401 seen in the Playwright automation to confirm it is not a real production auth regression (backend logins via API are healthy; the issue only manifested when re-entering the login form in a fresh page after a prior logged-in session).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 5974 lines. Consider splitting into modules (auth, contacts, master_files, bill_drafts, business_card) before it grows further — long-term maintainability risk.
_auto_save_draft_to_master_files (server.py L3670) swallows all exceptions with logger.warning; consider surfacing failures to the draft record so users know the file was not saved.

rca_of_issue: No unresolved production bug in this iteration. The Playwright automation observed transient 401 errors after re-login in a fresh browser context (login form appeared to accept credentials but the client-side session was not persisted, and the URL remained on /login). Backend login via curl works reliably; suggest verifying manually via a web browser to rule out a real regression before shipping.
